items.markdown:
Peptides are `short chains of amino acids that act as building blocks for vital skin proteins like collagen and elastin`.[[1]](https://us.medik8.com/collections/peptides)

### How Peptides Work

- **Cellular Messengers:** They signal your skin cells to repair damage and produce new collagen.[[1]](https://www.adventhealth.com/blogs/what-are-peptides-skin-care)
- **Protein Protection:** Certain types inhibit enzymes that break down your skin's natural support structure.[[1]](https://www.adventhealth.com/blogs/what-are-peptides-skin-care)
- **Deep Penetration:** Because they are smaller than full proteins, they pass through the outer skin layer effectively.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7dyfRKfYNFs&t=34)

### Main Types of Peptides

- **Signal Peptides:** Trigger collagen and hyaluronic acid production to firm the skin (e.g., Matrixyl).[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9hAdhXJBexo&t=139)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7dyfRKfYNFs&t=34)
- **Carrier Peptides:** Deliver trace minerals like copper to boost healing and reduce inflammation.[[1]](https://www.adventhealth.com/blogs/what-are-peptides-skin-care)
- **Neurotransmitter Peptides:** Relax micro-contractions in facial muscles to smooth expression lines.[[1]](https://www.adventhealth.com/blogs/what-are-peptides-skin-care)
- **Enzyme-Inhibitor Peptides:** Protect existing collagen from breaking down.[[1]](https://www.adventhealth.com/blogs/what-are-peptides-skin-care)
